keyEvents.text: Goal! Racing de Santander 1, Real Sociedad 0. Yassir Zabiri (Racing de Santander) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Iker Luque.
Goal! Racing de Santander 2, Real Sociedad 0. Yassir Zabiri (Racing de Santander) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Racing de Santander 2, Real Sociedad 1. Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Sergio Gómez.
First Half ends, Racing de Santander 2, Real Sociedad 1.
Second Half begins Racing de Santander 2, Real Sociedad 1.
Goal! Racing de Santander 2, Real Sociedad 2. Gonçalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Jon Gorrotxategi following a corner.
Álex Remiro (Real Sociedad) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Racing de Santander 3, Real Sociedad 2. Sergio Canales (Racing de Santander) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Real Sociedad. Takefusa Kubo replaces Carlos Soler.
Substitution, Real Sociedad. Jon Aramburu replaces Héctor Fort.
